result.decision_reason: Withhold after independent risk audit (learner-critical-answer): Both translations fit the stated sense. However, the national contrast is overstated: “pengharum ruangan” is strongly established in Indonesian, while Malaysian usage also commonly includes “pewangi udara,” “pewangi bilik/rumah,” and “pewangi/penyegar udara.” Thus “penyegar udara” is valid Malaysian Malay but not a clean Malaysia-versus-Indonesia lexical distinction. No false-friend contrast is present. Retain outside promotion pending a vetted correction and fresh current clearance.
